title: Fred again.. Announces First Ever India Tour: ‘We Are Beyond Excited to Come’
summary: The three-date run will happen in December and will be Fred's only live shows in 2026.
contentText:
Fred again.. will embark on his first ever tour through India this December.

The producer announced the three-date run on Tuesday (June 23), unveiling details of shows happening at Leisure Valley Ground in Delhi NCR on Dec. 5, Mahalaxmi Race Course in Mumbai on Dec. 9 and NICE Grounds in Bengaluru on Dec. 13.

“Haven’t had this many messages from a place since we first toured Australia! We are beyond excited to come,” Fred wrote in a post announcing the shows, adding that “thanks to the good people of Scottish whisky aka Monkey Shoulder [#ad] we are able to offer tickets for ₹1,750 and ₹3,500 (about 18 dollars and 37 dollars). We really wanted to make that price possible whilst also bringing our full live show to a place we never been before. I am VERY happy about this because I desperately want anyone who would like to come to be able to come.”

Tickets for the shows go on sale June 30.

A press release for the run advises that these sets will be Fred’s only live shows (versus DJ sets) this year, and that they will include music from his first Actual Life album from 2021 through his most recent USB album. They will also be his first live shows since he played in Italy in September of 2025, and are also the only dates currently on the artist’s 2026 tour schedule.

Fred’s last performance was highly splashy, with him closing out his USB run with a b2b with Thomas Bangalter in London in February.
